pages.text: Press $(k:puffish_skills.open) to open the six skill trees, and plan before you spend. Skill points come from completing Heracles quests ($(k:heracles.open_quests)); grinding combat or XP earns none.$(br2)$(bold)Respeccing:$() each point refunded costs 5 XP levels. A full respec is possible but expensive.

$(bold)The Six Trees$()$(br)$(li)$(bold)Warfare$(): melee damage, weapon mastery, combat stats$(li)$(bold)Marksman$(): ranged damage, arrow handling, precision$(li)$(bold)Sorcery$(): spell power, mana, cast efficiency$(li)$(bold)Fortitude$(): HP, defense, regen, resistance$(li)$(bold)Gathering$(): mining, farming, fishing, luck$(li)$(bold)Engineering$(): crafting, machine bonuses, automation speed

$(bold)Point Budget$()$(br2)Finish every quest in every tier and you earn about $(bold)75 skill points$() in total. Each tree has 40 levels to invest in, so maxing all six would take $(bold)240 points$(). That is out of reach on purpose: you will have to specialize.$(br2)Pufferfish Unofficial Additions stops you grinding specific XP sources for points.

$(bold)Tree Structure$()$(br2)Each tree has:$(li)$(bold)8-node trunk$(): always open, with the base bonuses.$(li)$(bold)2 branches$(): specialized substyles that unlock after trunk nodes.$(li)$(bold)1 capstone$(): a strong late bonus for near-full investment.$(br2)Each fork is exclusive: you take one branch or the other.$(br2)$(bold)Next: press $(k:puffish_skills.open) and pick your class's tree.$()
